description: Create a new, empty Matrix context (a document collection) and pass chunking_strategy "structural": PDFs are split along their layout (articles, headings, tables), other formats (Word, Excel, text, HTML) by their headings, with no language model. The configured search model is bound automatically; if it still has to be downloaded the answer says so: call setup_embedding_model, the user approves that call. Next: add_files.
